tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij zdania (1.1.-1.6.), wykorzystujac podane w nawiasach wyrazy w odpowiedniej formie. Nie zmieniaj kolejnosci podanych wyrazow, ale w razie potrzeby dodaj inne wyrazy, tak aby otrzymac logiczne i gramatycznie poprawne zdania. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna.

items.context: I remember _________ (lock) the door, but now I am not sure. I had better _________ (go) back and check.

_________ (see) from above, the island looks like a horseshoe. It is well worth _________ (visit).
He is used to _________ (work) nights, but he would prefer _________ (start) earlier.
_________ (finish) the report, she went straight to bed. She was far too tired _________ (eat) anything.
They made us _________ (rewrite) the whole essay, and we were not allowed _________ (use) our notes.
